books.title: Principles of Visual Information Retrieval
books.creator: Michael S. Lew (editor)
books.why: A foundational view of how images and video are represented, compared, ranked and retrieved: colour, texture, shape, similarity, feature selection, feedback, video indexing and semantics.
books.note: Photographed 9 November 2026. Historical pre-deep-learning methods; compare with modern vision embeddings.

books.title: Video Mining
books.creator: Azriel Rosenfeld, David Doermann and Daniel DeMenthon (editors)
books.availability: ResearchGate lists full-text PDF, but direct download returned HTTP 403; full PDF not verified in Drive
books.why: A historical foundation for video search and video understanding, connecting video indexing, content analysis, and extraction of meaningful events.
books.note: Photographed 11 November 2026. ResearchGate book page: https://www.researchgate.net/publication/321600652_Video_Mining. Full-book direct download not verified; no PDF uploaded to Drive.

books.title: Book of Proof
books.creator: Richard Hammack
books.why: A practical introduction to mathematical reasoning and proof techniques.

books.title: Proofs: A Long-Form Mathematics Textbook
books.creator: Jay Cummings
books.why: A long-form teaching approach to constructing and understanding proofs.

books.title: Real Analysis: A Long-Form Mathematics Textbook
books.creator: Jay Cummings
books.why: Develops rigorous understanding of limits, continuity and analysis.

books.title: Math History: A Long-Form Mathematics Textbook
books.creator: Jay Cummings
books.why: Places mathematical ideas in their historical context.

books.title: Linear Algebra and Its Applications
books.creator: Gilbert Strang
books.why: A conceptual and applied introduction to linear algebra; the link is to the author's resources, not a free textbook copy.

books.title: How to Prove It: A Structured Approach
books.creator: Daniel J. Velleman
books.why: Teaches how to unpack definitions and build mathematical proofs.

books.title: Crack Any Codebase with AI
books.creator: Zachary Huang
books.why: Practical techniques for exploring unfamiliar codebases with AI tools.

books.title: Visual Question Answering: From Theory to Application
books.creator: Qi Wu, Peng Wang, Xin Wang, Xiaodong He and Wenwu Zhu
books.availability: No verified freely available full-book PDF; publisher subscription
books.why: A survey-style textbook on VQA across images and videos, with chapters on video representation learning, advanced video QA, and grounded multimodal reasoning.
books.note: Photographed 11 November 2026. Research article by Qi Wu and collaborators available open access separately; do not confuse an article with the book. No full-book PDF uploaded to Drive.

books.title: Applied Machine Learning
books.creator: David A. Forsyth
books.topic: Practical machine learning; classical ML with computer vision applications
books.availability: Publisher PDF is available only with institutional or paid access; not verified free
books.why: A practical bridge from statistical learning to real applications: classification, SVMs, forests, high-dimensional data, regression, clustering, EM, HMMs and image-focused neural networks. Forsyth is a leading computer vision researcher, coauthor of Computer Vision: A Modern Approach.

books.title: The Nature of Statistical Learning Theory
books.creator: Vladimir N. Vapnik
books.availability: Official Springer front-matter PDF link only; complete PDF requires subscription, library access or purchase
books.why: One of the foundational accounts of why learning from finite data can generalize: capacity control, empirical risk minimization, convergence bounds and support vector methods. Specifically recommended in the acknowledgments of Forsyth's Applied Machine Learning.
books.note: Cited in Forsyth acknowledgments: Springer 1999. Second edition copyright 2000. No verified authorized open-access full PDF.

books.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
books.creator: Ethem Alpaydın
books.availability: Publisher HTML preview; no verified authorized free full PDF
books.why: A broad, structured treatment of supervised, unsupervised and probabilistic learning, from Bayesian decision theory to deep neural networks and reinforcement learning.
books.note: Photographed 9 November 2026. MIT Press 2020; ISBN 9780262043793. Official preview: https://mitpress.ublish.com/book/introduction-to-machine-learning--4

books.title: Foundations of Machine Learning
books.creator: Mehryar Mohri, Afshin Rostamizadeh and Ameet Talwalkar
books.why: A rigorous graduate-level framework for understanding generalization, PAC learning, capacity, kernels, boosting, model selection and algorithmic stability, with useful proofs and exercises.
books.note: Photographed 9 November 2026. Official author page: https://cs.nyu.edu/~mohri/mlbook/; MIT Press 2018.

books.title: Neural Networks and Learning Machines
books.creator: Simon Haykin
books.availability: No verified authorized free full PDF
books.why: A classic engineering-focused treatment connecting neuron models, multilayer networks, backpropagation, kernel machines, regularization, PCA, self-organizing maps and recurrent dynamics. Useful for understanding the mathematical and signal-processing roots of modern deep learning.
books.note: Third edition originally published in 2008 (copyright 2009); Pearson India also lists a 2016 printing.

books.title: Neural Networks: A Systematic Introduction
books.creator: Raúl Rojas
books.topic: Foundations and mathematics of neural networks
books.availability: Free authorized full PDF from author's university
books.why: Builds neural-network theory systematically from threshold logic and perceptrons through backpropagation, statistical learning, associative memory, Hopfield and Kohonen networks. Especially good for a rigorous view of classical connectionist models.
books.note: Springer 1996. Complete PDF verified on the author's Free University of Berlin website.

books.title: Fluent Python
books.creator: Luciano Ramalho
books.topic: Python programming, language idioms, and data structures
books.availability: Official publisher online preview and author companion material; no verified authorized free full-book PDF
books.why: An in-depth guide to writing idiomatic Python: data models, collections, functions, protocols, generators, coroutines, concurrency, and metaprogramming. Particularly valuable once you know Python syntax and want to understand how the language works.
books.note: The second edition, published by O’Reilly in April 2022. Includes example code and an official companion site.

books.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
books.creator: Marc Peter Deisenroth, A. Aldo Faisal and Cheng Soon Ong
books.why: Start here for an integrated path from linear algebra, matrix decompositions, vector calculus, probability and optimization to linear regression, PCA, Gaussian mixtures and SVMs.
books.note: Suggested first read. Part I establishes the math; Part II shows how four standard ML methods use it.

books.title: Linear Algebra Done Right
books.creator: Sheldon Axler
books.edition: Fourth edition (open access; PDF corrected November 2026)
books.topic: Proof-based linear algebra and spectral methods
books.why: A rigorous second pass through linear algebra: understand linear operators, eigenvectors, inner products and SVD before relying on them in PCA, embeddings and low-rank methods.
books.note: Focus after the basics on chapters 5–7 (eigenvalues, inner products, SVD); this is proof-oriented rather than a computational first course.

books.title: Calculus
books.creator: Gilbert Strang
books.why: An accessible full calculus reference, connecting rates of change, integration, the chain rule and multivariable gradients. The derivatives and gradient chapters make backpropagation and gradient-based optimization easier to derive.
books.note: Originally published in 1991. Suggested ML-focused route: chapters 2 (derivatives), 4 (chain rule) and 13 (partial derivatives and gradients).

books.title: Introduction to Probability
books.creator: Joseph K. Blitzstein and Jessica Hwang
books.topic: Probability, conditional reasoning and random variables
books.availability: Free author-authorized full PDF viewer (Harvard Stat 110)
books.why: A story-driven route from counting and conditional probability through distributions and expectation to Markov chains. Useful for Bayesian reasoning, model uncertainty and diagnosing classifier errors.
books.note: Harvard Stat 110 textbook. Give chapter 2 on conditional probability and Bayes' rule extra attention; the authorized PDF link opens a Google Drive viewer.

books.title: Convex Optimization
books.creator: Stephen Boyd and Lieven Vandenberghe
books.topic: Convex analysis, optimization algorithms and duality
books.availability: Free authorized full PDF (Stanford authors' site)
books.why: The standard treatment of when optimization problems have global solutions and how to solve them efficiently. Especially useful for understanding convex losses, regularization, constrained models and duality.
books.note: Read chapters 2–5 for convex foundations and duality, then chapter 9 for unconstrained optimization. Neural-network training is generally nonconvex, but many of its tools begin here.
